email.subject: POAP KINGS (#J2RGCRVG) — war-focused clan with POAPs + Free Pass Royale (2000+)
email.body:
Hey — we’re recruiting for POAP KINGS (#J2RGCRVG).

If you want a Clash Royale clan that actually runs like a team (and remembers what happens), this is us. We’re competitive in Clan Wars, warm with people, and builder-minded outside the game: POAPs, tracked milestones, and real traditions.

Quick snapshot:
- Members: 22
- Required trophies: 2,000+
- Combined trophies: 165,446
- Weekly donations: 1,704
- Avg member level: 42.5
- Clan war trophies: 140

What makes POAP KINGS different:
- War focus with accountability (without drama). If you can play wars, we want you using your decks and helping the boat.
- POAP culture: we collect season + milestone “Proof of Attendance / Proof of Arena Push” moments.
- Free Pass Royale tradition: our season War Champ (top war contributor) can earn a free Pass Royale.
- We even have Elixir (our clan chronicler/operator) helping us track wars, milestones, and shout-outs so effort doesn’t disappear.

Real people, real output:
- Ladder leaders: raquaza (12,283), Vijay (12,065), King Levy (11,500)
- Donation leaders: Chanco (308), JaxikoLane (258), raquaza (244), Vijay (234), King Levy (212)
- Player flavor:
  - King Thing (Leader): known for Royal Ghost + Witch
  - JaxikoLane (Elder): Goblin Barrel pressure

What we’re looking for:
- 2,000+ trophies (higher is great, but reliability matters more)
- War participation when you’re able (real life first)
- Donating and being a good teammate

If that sounds like your kind of clan, check us out and hop in:
https://poapkings.com
